name: Say 'have' / 'need' as the obligation verb (will have, you need)
description: Promotes the obligation verb "have" (to) / "need" after a subject, modal or negated auxiliary across many contexts ("Vinod will have" to pay, "First things first - you need", "it doesn't have", "it has got", "financial need"). Ablated, the model prefers "pay" (p ≈ 1.00 after "will"), "change" (p ≈ 0.99), "take", "to", "be" or "hardship".
